geos.title: Countries
geos.description: One or more two letter country codes to pull trending searches for, e.g. US, GB, IN, DE, JP, BR. Each country runs as its own feed.

includeNews.title: Include related news
includeNews.description: Attach the news articles driving each trend (title, source, link, image). Turn off for just the terms and volumes.

maxNewsPerTrend.title: Max news items per trend
maxNewsPerTrend.description: Cap on related news articles attached to each trending term.

maxPerGeo.title: Max trends per country
maxPerGeo.description: Cap on trending searches returned per country (Google serves roughly 10 to 20 at a time).

maxRows.title: Max trends total
maxRows.description: Maximum number of trend rows to return across all countries. First 15 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The trends RSS feed is a tolerant public source, so proxy is off by default. Supply one only if you pull many countries and hit rate limits.
